title: Screening shows whether correctness can be proven (S7)
body:
Source: Fable architecture decision 2026-11-15, docs/program/plan.md S7 (Sector 2 — Proof (ADR 0021; north-star item 5)); program t-b160jt0.
Why: ADR 0021 — moves the north-star items named in the plan sector.
Outcome: at least 70 post-June-2026 units with issue-only bodies; arm A screened on a separate run; go only if A passes at most 85%
Files: see ADR 0021 Consequences.
Proof: `node evals/replay/run.ts --screen --report: prints A pass rate and go/no-go`
Predicted: metric abc-screen-a-pass-rate <= 0.85
After: S6
